note: recorded in docs/SealCriticalSection_Runbook_Evidence.md. The seal script writes one path under artifacts/ (gitignored), so the JSON body was overwritten in place when seq 2 was taken; the hash above is what survives of it, and it is enough to say which seal an L2 run would have referenced.

the hash is deliberately NOT copied here. A seal binds commit_sha, so writing its hash into a tracked file changes HEAD and invalidates the very hash just written. The seal record is the authority for its own identity; this ledger records the CHAIN.
